verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents three agent-usable write paths: an Admin API covering everything the dashboard can do (creating and updating flags), an official CLI for managing flags, and an official MCP server. On the governance side, Feature Change Requests provide a create/approve/publish four-eyes workflow, RBAC can restrict who modifies production, and Release Pipelines can auto-generate change requests when promoting to production. missing for 10: explicit documentation that change-request enforcement applies to API/MCP/CLI-token writes rather than only the dashboard, a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent being gated by approvals.
